create_canine_config: create a CanineConfig instance with default google/canine-s configuration parameters
create_canine_config_custom: create a CanineConfig instance with custom downsampling_rate, upsampling_kernel_size, and num_hash_functions
review_canine_config: review the CanineConfig class and its transformer configuration attributes like hidden_size and num_hidden_layers
summarize_canine_config: summarize the CanineConfig class attributes and their default values for the CANINE model
create_canine_model_config: create a CanineConfig and initialize a CanineModel with random weights from the configuration
